thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: Sev2 — unusual auth 401 spike + possible leaked staging logs (alert id: ALRT-5234). Paging @maria (oncall) and @priya (sec).

maria (oncall): oncall ack — I’m looking now, putting the channel into incident mode.

jonathan (sre-lead): seeing 401s jump on auth-proxy across us-east-1 and eu-west-1, ~12% failure rate for /v1/session. 3 source IP ranges spiking.

priya (sec): correlating alerts — log-indexer flagged raw Authorization headers in index "staging-raw-requests" between 2024-11-08T02:14 and 04:20 UTC. Looks like a pipeline ingested full request headers into S3 -> index.

maria (oncall): confirmed. How big is the window and which buckets?

priya (sec): window ~2h. Affected bucket: redwood-staging-logs. Objects containing headers: s3://redwood-staging-logs/raw/2024-11-08/*. Some objects include bearer tokens.

kevin - sec: treat as suspected credential exposure. Immediate mitigations: 1) rotate any staging service keys that could be live, 2) revoke session tokens issued during window, 3) block suspicious IP ranges at edge.

jonathan (sre-lead): applying IP blocklist now to edge WAF for the 3 CIDR ranges showing highest volume. Will patch in 30s. Expect transient 401 increase while we revoke.

deploy-bot: deploy start: edge-waf-blocklist-v2 (change set ID: cs-789) — estimated 15s to rollout.

maria (oncall): revoke sessions for tokens issued in that window. Priya, can you give me the token prefixes/IDs to target?

priya (sec): pulling token list now. Preliminary: session tokens with prefixes: stg_3a4f*, stg_7b2d*; svcacct-ingest key used by log pipeline: svc-ingest-01.

maria (oncall): revoking stg_3a4f* and stg_7b2d* sessions. Jon, can you disable svc-ingest-01 in IAM immediately?

jonathan (sre-lead): disabling now. Command: `aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIAEXAMPLE --status Inactive --user-name svc-ingest` (done).

kevin - sec: rotating keys — Priya and I will create new keys, push to KMS, then update staging pipeline credentials. Plan: rotate staging keys now, production keys only if we confirm cross-environment leak.

priya (sec): copying list of suspected credentials: ["svc-ingest-01","staging-api-key","staging-deploy-runner"]. Will rotate svc-ingest-01 and staging-api-key immediately. staging-deploy-runner will be rotated after pipeline validation.

sara-cs: customer impact? Any customer-facing outages?

maria (oncall): mitigation will cause a short window of increased 401s (revocations + WAF blocks). Early estimate: <1% of production auths impacted for ~10-20m. Affected customers: internal staging tenants and a handful of early-access customers on staging routes. No production customer data confirmed leaked.

sara-cs: prepping support template and status page blurb. Please send me exact time window and list of rotated keys when available.

priya (sec): we found examples of full Authorization headers in those S3 objects, but tokens appear to be staging environment tokens. No production tokens seen in initial scan (still scanning). Treat as PII/credentials exposure for compliance.

legal: looping in compliance — please hold for us, will advise on notification threshold.

maria (oncall): action items assigned: jonathan — block IP ranges + disable svc-ingest-01 (done). priya/kevin — rotate staging keys and validate pipeline. sara-cs — publish support note and flag customers. legal — standby for notification AND collect scope. I'll coordinate post-mortem.

jonathan (sre-lead): WAF rule active. Edge telemetry shows ingress from listed CIDRs decreasing. Revocations pushed to session service; tok revocations TTL enforcement in progress.

priya (sec): rotation done for svc-ingest-01 and staging-api-key, new creds pushed to KMS and pipeline updated. Running smoke tests against staging ingest to confirm no residual header logging.

maria (oncall): smoke tests green. Still scanning for any cross-env tokens. If we find prod tokens, escalate to Sev1 and rotate production keys immediately.

kevin - sec: remediation notes (for post-mortem): 1) update pipeline to strip request headers before S3 write, 2) add schema validation to log-indexer, 3) enforce S3 object-level encryption + access review.

sara-cs: support template drafted and live on internal status page. Notifying 5 affected customers now (low severity language, remediation in progress).

legal: please upload incident summary to secure folder INC-5234 and include decision tree for public notification.

maria (oncall): next update in 30 minutes or sooner if scope changes. If anyone discovers prod tokens in objects — post immediately in this thread with object key and timestamp.

incident-bot: Incident mode ON — reminder: run retrospective checklist when incident moves to resolved.

jonathan (sre-lead): follow-up note — created ticket INC-5234 in ops with timeline and actions. Assigning to maria, priya, kevin.

maria (oncall): thanks all. Good triage so far. I’ll keep this channel updated.
